arithmetic: exact integer, finite-ring and rational arithmetic
new_work: Exact global weak-wire contraction via local weighted superset transforms and precision-budgeted subsets, with explicit state-dependent bit cost.
Exact minimum separated boundary dimension over Z/(2^p), including arbitrary positive valuations and odd parts.
Positive binary-clause CNFs realizing the same conditional-count kernels.
Uniform polynomial CNF compiler to bounded-arity constant-entry weak-wire networks, with Z=2^E #F and p=E+n+1.
Valid repeated-simple-Cauchy coefficient formula from confluence, and an explicit source-mode family falsifying its naive higher-mode extension.
remaining_gap: No removal of the global retained-state cost for unrestricted SAT, no polynomial-bit conditional marginal evaluator, and no unrestricted lower bound.
scope_limits: Separated boundary rank is a representation lower bound, not a general algorithm lower bound.
The weak-wire reduction demonstrates retained SAT generality, not impossibility.
The global contraction algorithm is exponential when its retained-state count is exponential.
The source-mode counterexample falsifies one determinant quotient, not all determinant methods or the pinned source theorem.
No assertion is made that the pinned deterministic layout necessarily realizes a chosen global gadget or small three-row example.
target: Unrestricted uniform deterministic classical SAT search/decision, polynomial bit complexity in complete binary input length.
